plugin.name: Hyprland Monitor Manager
plugin.description: Aesthetic visual display manager for Hyprland

config_path.label: Monitors Config Path
config_path.description: Path to persistent Hyprland monitors file (default: ~/.config/hypr/monitors.conf)

safety_timeout.label: Safety Revert Timeout
safety_timeout.description: Seconds before auto-reverting unconfirmed display changes

enable_safety_timer.label: Enable Safety Timer
enable_safety_timer.description: Auto-revert unconfirmed display changes to protect against black screens

auto_switch_profiles.label: Auto-Switch Profiles
auto_switch_profiles.description: Automatically activate matching profile when monitors are plugged or unplugged

show_count_in_bar.label: Show Count in Bar
show_count_in_bar.description: Display active screen count next to the status bar icon

enable_vrr_options.label: Show Gaming / VRR Controls
enable_vrr_options.description: Show Variable Refresh Rate (Adaptive Sync) and bitdepth options

panel.title: Hyprland Monitor Manager
panel.subtitle: {count} Connected Monitors
panel.canvas_help: Click monitor to inspect. Use snap buttons to align positions.
panel.safety_desc: Settings applied. Auto-reverting in {seconds}s if not confirmed.
